about: module sqlite's mutants (ORCH-1); each guards WAL/busy_timeout pragmas, BEGIN IMMEDIATE write-lock serialization, or SQLite error classification into std sql.Failure.

mutants.name: sqlite-unique-not-classified
mutants.rule: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE (2067) and SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_PRIMARYKEY (1555) classify as sql.Unique: sqlite.ClassifyUniqueCodes.

mutants.name: sqlite-wal-omitted
mutants.rule: File-backed SQLite databases configure journal_mode(WAL) when WAL is enabled: sqlite.DefaultFileDSNHasConcurrencyPragmas.

mutants.name: sqlite-busy-timeout-omitted
mutants.rule: SQLite connections configure busy_timeout before journal_mode so concurrent writers wait cleanly: sqlite.DefaultFileDSNHasConcurrencyPragmas.

mutants.name: sqlite-driver-begin-deferred
mutants.from:
func (d *DB) BeginImmediate(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
	tx, err := d.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
mutants.to:
func (d *DB) BeginImmediate(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
	tx, err := d.db.BeginTx(ctx, &dbsql.TxOptions{ReadOnly: true})
mutants.rule: BeginImmediate acquires SQLite's write lock up front instead of starting a deferred transaction: driver TestBeginImmediateAcquiresLockUpFront.

mutants.name: sqlite-actorstore-lease-fence-bypassed
mutants.rule: SaveTransitionWith rejects writes from stale leased incarnations with actor.StaleLease inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE.

mutants.name: sqlite-actorstore-acquire-reuses-epoch
mutants.rule: AcquireLease monotonically advances the lease epoch so prior writers are fenced.

mutants.name: sqlite-actorstore-timer-resets-on-recovery
mutants.rule: prepareSQLiteHooks restores RemainingDelay from the persisted TimerAnchor across crashes and server upgrades.

mutants.name: sqlite-actorstore-pending-returns-acked
mutants.from: let rows = try db.Query("SELECT seq, actor_id, epoch, payload FROM actor_outbox WHERE actor_id = ? AND acked = 0 ORDER BY seq ASC", []sql.Value{sql.Text{S: actorID}})
mutants.to: let rows = try db.Query("SELECT seq, actor_id, epoch, payload FROM actor_outbox WHERE actor_id = ? ORDER BY seq ASC", []sql.Value{sql.Text{S: actorID}})
mutants.rule: PendingOutbox returns only unacknowledged outbox rows.
